headline: Anthropic Lockup Expirations Threaten Stock Oversupply Risk After IPO
summary: Billions of locked-up shares in artificial intelligence startup Anthropic could pose supply overhang pressure on its stock price over the coming year post-IPO.
why: Anthropic is a prominent generative artificial intelligence firm. Post-IPO share lockup expirations allow early investors and employees to sell shares, potentially increasing market supply.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Potential oversupply from locked-up shares entering trading could create downward price pressure.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
